result.summary: Found 2 visual issues. The most noticeable problem is overlapping restaurant detail text in the “Popular right now” section. There is also content partially hidden behind the fixed bottom navigation.

issues.description: In the “Tokumaru Ramen Bar” card, the metadata line below the restaurant name is visually overlapping. The delivery time and delivery fee text appear stacked on top of each other, making it hard to read.
issues.suggestion: Adjust the layout spacing and text container widths for the restaurant metadata row. Ensure each item has enough horizontal space or wraps cleanly without overlapping.

issues.description: The bottom navigation bar appears to cover part of the next restaurant card image near the bottom of the screen.
issues.suggestion: Add sufficient bottom padding to the scrollable content so cards are not hidden underneath the fixed navigation bar.
